From 104016eb671e19709721c1b0048dd912dc2e96be Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jacob Moroni <jmoroni@google.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 23:41:53 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] RDMA/umem: Fix double dma_buf_unpin in failure path

In ib_umem_dmabuf_get_pinned_with_dma_device(), the call to
ib_umem_dmabuf_map_pages() can fail. If this occurs, the dmabuf
is immediately unpinned but the umem_dmabuf->pinned flag is still
set. Then, when ib_umem_release() is called, it calls
ib_umem_dmabuf_revoke() which will call dma_buf_unpin() again.

Fix this by removing the immediate unpin upon failure and just let
the ib_umem_release/revoke path handle it. This also ensures the
proper unmap-unpin unwind ordering if the dmabuf_map_pages call
happened to fail due to dma_resv_wait_timeout (and therefore has
a non-NULL umem_dmabuf->sgt).

Fixes: 1e4df4a21c5a ("RDMA/umem: Allow pinned dmabuf umem usage")
Signed-off-by: Jacob Moroni <jmoroni@google.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260224234153.1207849-1-jmoroni@google.com
Signed-off-by: Leon Romanovsky <leon@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/infiniband/core/umem_dmabuf.c b/drivers/infiniband/core/umem_dmabuf.c
index f5298c33e581..d30f24b90bca 100644
--- a/drivers/infiniband/core/umem_dmabuf.c
+++ b/drivers/infiniband/core/umem_dmabuf.c
@@ -218,13 +218,11 @@ ib_umem_dmabuf_get_pinned_with_dma_device(struct ib_device *device,
 
 	err = ib_umem_dmabuf_map_pages(umem_dmabuf);
 	if (err)
-		goto err_unpin;
+		goto err_release;
 	dma_resv_unlock(umem_dmabuf->attach->dmabuf->resv);
 
 	return umem_dmabuf;
 
-err_unpin:
-	dma_buf_unpin(umem_dmabuf->attach);
 err_release:
 	dma_resv_unlock(umem_dmabuf->attach->dmabuf->resv);
 	ib_umem_release(&umem_dmabuf->umem);
-- 
2.34.1

The patch fixes a bug in `ib_umem_dmabuf_get_pinned_with_dma_device()` where a double `dma_buf_unpin()` could occur in the failure path of `ib_umem_dmabuf_map_pages()`.  

**File modified:** `drivers/infiniband/core/umem_dmabuf.c`

**Change summary:**  
- Removed the `err_unpin` label and its associated `dma_buf_unpin()` call that was executed when `ib_umem_dmabuf_map_pages()` failed.  
- The failure path now jumps directly to `err_release`, which calls `ib_umem_release()`. This later cleanup correctly handles both unpinning the dmabuf and freeing the scatter-gather table (if present), avoiding a double unpin and ensuring proper unmap-unpin ordering.  

**Rationale:**  
The original code prematurely unpinned the dmabuf while leaving the `pinned` flag set, causing `ib_umem_release()` → `ib_umem_dmabuf_revoke()` to call `dma_buf_unpin()` again. By deferring all cleanup to the release path, the double unpin is eliminated and the correct sequence (unmap before unpin) is maintained.
